player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} ci Connect Four.
Bennu ngone: {symbol}.
Taflé bi amna {num_rows} rawu ak {num_cols} koli.
Jàngoro yi ñëw ñëw ñu joxe seen bennu ci benn koli (0 ba {end_col}).
Képp ku ci gën a jël (bennam) ñeenti bennu ci suuf, wëram, mbaa ci diggante.
Ci tawu ngone, bindaayu koli bi ci squared brackets ngir def seen taw.
Nekk na: '[col 4]' mbaa '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Jëfandikukat bii du gis jokkoo yi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jàngoro {player_id}, Formatu taw bi du saaf. Format biy joge: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jàngoro {player_id}, Taw bi du saaf. Koli {col} du ci diggante.
invalid_move.already_full: Jàngoro {player_id}, Taw bi du saaf. Koli {col} tasse.

action.dropped_disk: Jigeen {player_id} tàmbli na disk ({player_symbol}) ci colom {col}.

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat bi {player_id} moo ci jël ñeent!
